label: PLC 1x2 SC/APC, spliced tail
notes: Insertion loss 3.6 dB is a typical 1:2 PLC cassette: the ideal split of 3.01 dB plus 0.59 dB of excess loss. Both the excess and the total are typical values - the excess is the difference between the two, not a figure from a vendor sheet - and ITU-T G.671's insertion-loss requirement for a 1x2 branching component on a normal-reach span (WR1) is 2.8 dB min / 3.9 dB max, so a cassette you buy may sit up to 0.3 dB above this row. Modelled as a spliced cassette: one splice on the input tail and no connector pair charged, although the "-sca" suffix names the SC/APC-adapter variant. A fully connectorised cassette costs two connectors instead, about 0.5 dB more per splitter. Replace with the purchased cassette's datasheet.
